findings.quote: Complete each sentence with the modal that fits the stated meaning: "Rosa (can / must) swim well" describes ability. "You (may / must) leave now" gives permission. "Under the rule, staff (must / might) wear IDs" states a requirement. "It (might / must) rain" states only a possibility.
